text.tspan: Prerequisites: external IdP access token, space membership, registered type and policy, versioned bucket
All control requests carry Bearer JWT, API validates signature,
issuer, audience, expiry and exchange scope
Service checks current membership and applicable ownership,

g.text: [Provider accepted bytes, but response was lost]

text.tspan: The SDK bounds PUT retries and the upload deadline, retries obtain fresh grants
S3 must expose one latest part per number, SeaweedFS 4.47 needs the pinned single-gateway compatibility build
SDK may retry POST R/{record}/publish, receive 409 attachments_not_verified,
GET the record and sleep while verification is pending
Verification marks attachments verified, the record
A lost successful PUT response is shown, other failures and cleanup use separate recovery paths
Large client uploads bypass the API, exact-version worker verification still checks all stored bytes

Uploading state, protocol and part size
ListParts after ownership and state checks
Existing part numbers, ETags and sizes
PUT part bytes directly using signed URL
POST A/grants again for the same part number
Sign a fresh grant for the
Fresh signed URL and required headers
Retry the same part number and bytes
HEAD private attempt key, then ListParts if no completed object
Current logical parts and their ETags
Select due verification work, recheck category,
GET exact object VersionId and stream bytes
If lease still owned, commit verified binding and
POST R/{record}/publish with persisted idempotency key
